Alex — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so nothing slips: 

• Key priorities you shared: reduce inference cost for batch reporting, 99th pct latency under 300ms for customer-facing queries, and support for VPC deployment for regulated data.
• Current constraints: internal procurement window is mid-May; security needs SOC2 evidence and a short on-prem proof-of-concept for data residency.

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send over the discovery notes and a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached).
2) If this still looks aligned, can we book a 30-min procurement readiness call w/ your procurement and security teams the week of May 3?
3) We can prepare an on-prem PoC checklist (timeline: ~2 weeks) and a cost estimate for Dedicated vs. hosted hybrids.

Attachments: redwood-discovery-notes.pdf (summary), RMP_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (draft)

If procurement window has moved or priority changed, let me know — happy to accommodate. If you want me to loop in our security lead (Neha) and solutions engineer (Marissa), I can do that in one thread.

Best,
